versions.changelog:
Initial release — quickly turn business questions into complete, structured dashboard specifications.

- Converts a business or monitoring question into an implementation-ready dashboard brief.
- Output includes detailed KPI cards, visualisation specs, layout guidance, filters, and data requirements.
- Ensures every chart has a key insight and is justified.
- Flags missing or unavailable data and anti-patterns in dashboard design.
- Designed for BI, data, and product teams to share with developers without needing follow-up meetings.
